look.why: A soft blush rose that echoes the pale pink-white wing bands while letting the rust-chestnut wings stand out.

size.measure: wingspan 24–27 cm (among the largest moths in the world by wing area)

habitat.text: Tropical and subtropical forests across Southeast Asia, southern China, India, and the Malay Archipelago.

diet.text: Citrus, cinnamon, and rambutan leaves as caterpillars; adults have no functional mouthparts and do not eat.

facts.text: Both forewing tips are shaped and patterned like snake heads to startle hungry birds and lizards.
Adult moths live entirely on fat reserves stored during their caterpillar stage, surviving only one to two weeks.

id.habitat: Hutan hujan tropis dan subtropis di Asia Tenggara, Tiongkok selatan, India, dan Kepulauan Nusantara.
id.diet: Daun jeruk, kayu manis, dan rambutan saat menjadi ulat; ngengat dewasa tidak memiliki mulut dan tidak makan.
facts: Kedua ujung sayap depannya berbentuk dan bermotif mirip kepala ular untuk mengejutkan burung dan kadal pemangsa.
Ngengat dewasa hidup sepenuhnya dari cadangan lemak saat fase ulat dan hanya bertahan satu hingga dua minggu.
